core_empirical_claim: Cross-sectional rs_spread quintile tier predicts differential forward t5_return (high-rs_spread quintile outperforms low-rs_spread quintile)
must_fail_for_disbelief: partition_group_compare median_spread of t5_return across rs_spread quintiles <= 0
null_competing_explanation: The t5_return differential across rs_spread quintiles is a small-sample artifact or confounded by market-wide level effects on 2026-08-02.

directional_reversal.description: High quintile no longer beats low quintile on t5_return

replication_failure.description: Same partition test on independent dates fails to reproduce spread
replication_failure.strength: MODERATE — tests generalization beyond first supportive run

episode_instability.description: Effect disappears when focal date 2026-08-02 excluded (date-artifact)

context_instability.description: Effect holds only in narrow market regime not in proposition scope
context_instability.strength: WEAK for falsification — population narrowing risks rescue

population_instability.description: Driven by few symbols; leave-one-symbol collapses contrast

horizon_instability.strength: NOT VALID — changes proposition horizon (anti-rescue violation)

alternative_explanation.description: Confounding market-wide level effect on focal date

statistical_non_resolution.description: Spread too small to resolve after support
statistical_non_resolution.strength: NON-FALSIFICATION — would not weaken SUPPORTED state

strongest_pre_registered: directional_reversal via partition_group_compare median_spread <= 0 or rank reversal
